name: Princess Power
description: Princess friends from four different Fruitdoms — Blueberry, Kiwi, Pineapple and Raspberry — spring into action to make their worlds a better place.

videos.title: Unstoppable Unpoppable Princesses
videos.overview: Penny creates a magic bubble to help clear away clutter. But it works a little too well when Mr. Scrumples and a few friends get trapped inside of it!

videos.title: Princesses Garden Party
videos.overview: Frogs, stormy weather and a lost crown — oh, my! Can Kira and the princesses help acting queen Karina pull off the perfect party in the Kiwi Fruitdom?

videos.title: A Whale of a Princess Tale
videos.overview: The princess crew rolls out a royal rescue mission when Bea and Sir Benedict discover a friendly whale stuck on the beach.

videos.title: Princess Creation Station
videos.overview: Rita's promised a friendship bracelet to every kid in the Raspberry Fruitdom! That's a lot of wrists — so she'll need extra hands to help her make them.

videos.title: Happy Princess Birthday Fussy
videos.overview: It's Ms. Fussywiggles' birthday, and she's ready to take center stage. But disaster after disaster finds her spending the day happily helping others.

videos.title: Princess Lights Out
videos.overview: When a power outage brings Fruitizen life to a standstill, the determined princesses go the distance to get their Fruitdoms back online.

videos.title: Princess Shooting Stars
videos.overview: A once-in-a-millennium meteor shower is falling on the night of the very first Four Fruitdoms gathering. Time for a celestial celebration!

videos.title: Princess Royal Portrait
videos.overview: The princesses pitch in on royal duties at the Raspberry Palace so that Rita can paint an important piece of history: her mom's official portrait.

videos.title: A Princess Dad-Dilemma
videos.overview: It's a problem of parental proportions when King Barton gets stranded on an island swimming with surprises! Can Bea and her friends swoop in to save him?

videos.title: The Great Princess Punchbowl Feastival
videos.overview: When all of the Fruitdoms announce they're throwing a festival on the same day, the princesses hatch a plan to combine all four celebrations into one.

videos.title: Princess Fun in the Sun
videos.overview: The girls join forces to cool off the beach when a heat wave hits the Pineapple Fruitdom on the day of Great Aunt Busyboots' big speech.

videos.title: The Princesses and the Bees
videos.overview: Raspberry Day is right around the corner, but Rita's berry crop is refusing to grow! Can her can-do crew get things buzzing again?

videos.title: Princesses Soccer Spectacular
videos.overview: Rita tries to make things easier for a blind soccer player but winds up treating her differently than everyone else on the team. And that's not the goal!

videos.title: A Prince in the Princess Pack
videos.overview: It's a special day at the Pineapple Palace: Famous poet Gabriela Goldenrod is coming to visit — and so is Penny's little brother, Felipe!

videos.title: The Princesses and the Frosty Fruitdom Fiasco
videos.overview: On the day of the once-in-a-lifetime Kiwi Tricentennial, a rare snowstorm hits the Fruitdom. Can the princesses work together to save the celebration?

videos.title: Practice Makes Princess
videos.overview: No matter how much Bea practices the Guitarpsichord, she can't seem to learn the instrument in time for her big debut at the Royal Blueberry Pageant.

videos.title: Princess Farmers' Market
videos.overview: After a bad harvest, the farmers market is fresh out of fruit. Can the princesses figure out a way to send crops from Punchbowl Island to those in need?

videos.title: The Princesses Get a Roommate
videos.overview: While repairing roofs throughout her Fruitdom, Kira runs out of spare rooms for displaced Fruitizens and houses a guest at the Punchbowl Treehouse.

videos.title: The Princess' Speech
videos.overview: Kira plans to give her first big royal speech to the Kiwians on banning plastic straws, but her nerves keep getting the best of her.

videos.title: Princess Suggestion Box
videos.overview: To make sure her Fruitizens have everything they need, Penny creates a royal suggestion box. The only problem? Now she's swamped with suggestions!

videos.title: The Missing Princess
videos.overview: When Rita gets lost hiking in the woods with the Raspberrian Rangers, the other princesses must follow clues to find their missing friend.

videos.title: Princess All-Nighter
videos.overview: At a Punchbowl Treehouse sleepover, Bea feels nervous about spending her first night away from home and tries to figure out a way to not fall asleep.

videos.title: Little Shop of Princess Horrors
videos.overview: At the Friendly Fruitdom Bake-off, the princesses compete for a chance to win the Golden Whiskerton Trophy — but there's a pineapple problem.

videos.title: Princess Surprise Party
videos.overview: When Bea's dads plan a surprise party for her a week before her birthday, the other princesses help by distracting their friend so she won't find out.

videos.title: I Dig Being a Princess
videos.overview: The princesses follow a mystery map in search of a prize for their Cuddly Critter Care Charity Ball. But what they find may change their world!

videos.title: The Princess Crown Cover Up
videos.overview: The Orange Queen is coming for an important, royal-rific gala! Can Rita fix the Raspberrian crown jewels before her mom finds out they're broken?

videos.title: Princess Processional Professional
videos.overview: Bea can't connect with her Fruitizens at the Blueberry Processional if she doesn't learn to ride her new horse, Bella Brunhilde Blueberry.

videos.title: How to Be a Princess
videos.overview: The princesses host a Princess Promise ceremony for Lila Lemon, but the soon-to-be princess feels more confident about tinkering than her royal skills.

videos.title: Princess Bon Voyage
videos.overview: Kira's not ready for Karina to leave for her study-at-sea program. Can the princesses create a day of Kiwi Sister Princess Power to convince her to stay?

videos.title: The Perfect Princess Welcome
videos.overview: When a kid-chef from the Lemon Fruitdom moves to the Kiwi Fruitdom, Kira welcomes him by inviting guests to his new cafe that features treats from home.

videos.title: Fussy and Scrumples' Princess Adventure
videos.overview: The princesses need to prepare for the first Fruitizen voyage of the Punchbowl Seahouse... but the dock floats away with Fussy and Mr. Scrumples on it!

videos.title: Princess Donation Distress
videos.overview: Rita has trouble parting with her things when the princesses organize a Royal Giveaway Day to gather items for the Lemonite kids impacted by the storm.

videos.title: Busyboots and the Four Princesses
videos.overview: When Great Aunt Busyboots catches a cold, Penny steps in to host a tea party for Queen Alana Apple and make a royal request for the Pineapple Parade.

videos.title: Princess Freaky Fruit-Day
videos.overview: Penny and her Great Aunt Busyboots decide to swap roles for the day so the queen can have a princess adventure and Penny can practice being queen.

videos.title: Four-Fruitdom Princess Coronation
videos.overview: When the seed silo breaks on the eve of their coronation, the princesses follow a riddle that sends them on a voyage to the Cave of Sparkleseed Secrets.

videos.title: Princess Camp Out Stake Out
videos.overview: To catch the critter that's been eating all the ripe raspberries off the bushes at night, the princesses go on a royal "camp out stake out."

videos.title: Princess Pie Surprise
videos.overview: After Bea accidentally botches a blueberry pie delivery, the princesses get creative to bake a fresh batch in time for the All-Fruitdom Treat-and-Greet.

videos.title: Princess Babysitters Club
videos.overview: Bea offers to babysit Queen Olivia's niece and nephew so the Fruitizens can attend "Fruitloose The Musical" — if she can distract the kids long enough.

videos.title: Princess Royal Wedding
videos.overview: Queen Ryung and Queen Olivia are getting married! Can Rita and her new little sister Omera plan a royal wedding while trying to impress a special guest?

videos.title: Princess Eco-Chase
videos.overview: On their first Crystal Key Quest, academy hopefuls compete in a Princess Eco-Chase — but Princess Delia Dragonfruit brings out Bea's competitive side.

videos.title: Princess Nest Pest
videos.overview: Kira follows a trail of sparkly feathers for the princesses' next Crystal Key Quest — and finds a much bigger surprise than she was expecting.

videos.title: Princess Bridge Over Troubled Water
videos.overview: The princesses search for pieces of the legendary Guac-enspiel in the Avocado Fruitdom, but the Avocadians are separated by water — and a grumpy shark.

videos.title: The Princesses and the Beanstalk
videos.overview: To release a tiny crystal key, the princesses need to water their Sparkleseed — but there's a four-Fruitdom drought. Time for a Precipitation Station!

videos.title: Princess Friends Un-Forever
videos.overview: After taking a day-long journey to a strange Fruitdom, the princesses encounter a tart-stealing mystery monster! Can they work together to catch it?

videos.title: Princesses Seas the Day
videos.overview: On their final Crystal Key Quest, the princesses must defend their Fruitizens from a pirate — even if it means giving up the Princess Adventure Academy.
